events.title: The Creation
events.blurb: Light divided from darkness, seas gathered, life called forth in order — and on the sixth day, man and woman in the image of God, with all pronounced very good.

events.title: The Fall of Adam & Eve
events.blurb: The serpent's question, the forbidden fruit, and eyes opened — the family of man leaves Eden with coats of skins and a promise about the seed of the woman.

events.title: The Flood
events.blurb: The fountains of the deep break open and rain falls forty days; only the ark rides above it, carrying Noah's family and every living kind to a washed-clean world.

events.title: The Tower of Babel
events.blurb: A tower whose top may reach unto heaven — until the Lord confounds the language of all the earth and scatters the builders across its face.

events.title: The Covenant with Abraham
events.blurb: Under a canopy of stars too many to number, the Lord covenants with Abram — land, posterity, and a new name: Abraham, father of many nations.

events.title: Isaac Offered on Moriah
events.blurb: Three days' journey, wood on the son's back, and a knife raised — then the angel's voice and a ram caught in the thicket. 'God will provide himself a lamb.'

events.title: Jacob Becomes Israel
events.blurb: Alone at Peniel, Jacob wrestles until the breaking of the day and will not let go without a blessing — and limps away with a new name: Israel.

events.title: Joseph Sold — and Exalted
events.blurb: Stripped of his coat and sold for twenty pieces of silver, the dreamer rises from pit to prison to Pharaoh's right hand, storing grain against seven years of famine.

events.title: The Exodus & the Red Sea
events.blurb: Israel marches out of Egypt between walls of standing water; Pharaoh's chariots follow and the sea returns. 'The Lord shall fight for you.'

events.title: The Law Given at Sinai
events.blurb: The mountain smokes, the trumpet sounds long, and God speaks ten words that will govern nations — while Israel trembles at the border of the camp.

events.title: Jordan Parts & Jericho Falls
events.blurb: Priests stand in a riverbed heaped dry, and a week later trumpets and a shout bring Jericho's walls down flat — Israel is home in the land of promise.

events.title: Deborah Judges Israel
events.blurb: From under her palm tree the prophetess summons Barak against nine hundred chariots of iron — and the stars in their courses fight against Sisera.

events.title: Gideon's Three Hundred
events.blurb: An army whittled from 32,000 to 300 so no one can boast — trumpets, torches, and broken pitchers rout the Midianite host by night.

events.title: Samson's Last Strength
events.blurb: Blinded and grinding at Gaza, the fallen Nazarite prays once more, grips the pillars of Dagon's house — and brings it down on the lords of the Philistines.

events.title: Ruth Chooses Naomi's God
events.blurb: In the famine-bitter days of the judges, a Moabite widow binds herself to her mother-in-law: 'whither thou goest, I will go... thy God my God.'

events.title: The Boy Samuel Is Called
events.blurb: In the quiet of the tabernacle at Shiloh, a voice calls a child by name three times in the night — 'Speak, Lord; for thy servant heareth.'

events.title: Saul Anointed Israel's First King
events.blurb: Israel demands a king like the nations; Samuel pours the oil on a tall young man found hiding among the baggage.

events.title: David & Goliath
events.blurb: A shepherd boy refuses the king's armor and runs toward the giant with a sling and five smooth stones — 'the battle is the Lord's.'

events.title: David King in Jerusalem
events.blurb: The tribes gather at Hebron to anoint the shepherd-king over all Israel; he takes the stronghold of Zion and makes Jerusalem his city.

events.title: Solomon Dedicates the Temple
events.blurb: The ark is carried into the Holy of Holies and glory fills the house so the priests cannot stand to minister — Solomon spreads his hands toward heaven.

events.title: The Kingdom Divides
events.blurb: Rehoboam answers the people roughly, ten tribes cry 'to your tents, O Israel' — and one nation becomes two: Israel in the north, Judah in the south.

events.title: Elijah on Mount Carmel
events.blurb: One prophet against 450 priests of Baal: 'How long halt ye between two opinions?' Fire falls on a drenched altar, and the people fall on their faces.

events.title: The Northern Kingdom Falls
events.blurb: Assyria besieges Samaria three years and carries Israel away — ten tribes scattered beyond the river, 'because they obeyed not the voice of the Lord.'

events.title: Jerusalem Falls to Babylon
events.blurb: The walls are broken, the temple burned, and Judah marched into exile in chains — the long night Jeremiah wept to foresee.

events.title: Ezekiel Sees the Dry Bones Live
events.blurb: In exile by the rivers of Babylon, the prophet is set down in a valley of bones — and prophesies until they stand, an exceeding great army: 'O my people, I will bring you home.'

events.title: The Return & the Second Temple
events.blurb: Cyrus of Persia proclaims liberty to the captives; the exiles come home with the temple vessels, and after twenty years of labor the second house is dedicated with joy.

events.title: Esther Saves Her People
events.blurb: Haman's decree hangs over every Jew in the empire; a hidden queen fasts three days and walks unbidden to the throne — 'if I perish, I perish.'

events.title: Jerusalem's Walls Rebuilt
events.blurb: Trowel in one hand and sword in the other, Nehemiah's builders finish the wall in fifty-two days — and their enemies perceive the work was wrought of God.

events.title: Malachi's Closing Promise
events.blurb: The Old Testament ends looking forward: the Sun of righteousness shall arise with healing in his wings, and Elijah shall come to turn the hearts of fathers and children.
